description: This file defines an object CanvasActionTrust that manages trust verification for canvas action URLs in an Android app, including URL normalization and matching logic.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is trusted based on predefined trusted URLs and specific rules.

methods.name: matchesTrustedRemoteA2uiUrlExact
methods.description: Compares a normalized candidate URI with a trusted URL string for exact match.

methods.name: normalizeTrustedRemoteA2uiUri
methods.description: Normalizes a URI by lowercasing scheme and host, only allowing http/https schemes, and ignoring fragments.

methods.name: parseUri
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a URI object, returning null if parsing fails.
